identifiedNFRs.requirement: User Error Protection: The password reset interface must enforce strong password validation rules, including minimum 12-character length, complexity requirements, and prevention of password reuse for the last 5 historical passwords.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Helps administrators maintain account security while providing clear guidance on password creation.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Recoverability: The system must provide a mechanism to notify the user via email or secure notification when their password is reset by an administrator.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Ensures users are immediately aware of unauthorized password changes.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Modularity: The password reset functionality must be implemented as a separate, configurable module that can be updated or replaced without affecting other system components.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Allows for future enhancements and security updates with minimal system disruption.

functionalRequirement: System shall be able to perform distance calculations and access geo-location information for the user, sites, and nearby sites.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Completeness: The system must accurately calculate distances between user, sites, and nearby sites using all required geo-location data types (e.g., latitude, longitude) for 100% of specified use cases.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires the system to perform distance calculations and access geo-location information, necessitating full coverage of these core functional aspects.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Time Behavior: The system must calculate distances between user, sites, and nearby sites in less than 100 milliseconds for up to 1,000 concurrent requests.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves real-time access to geo-location data and calculations, requiring timely responses for usability.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Confidentiality: The system must encrypt user geo-location data using TLS 1.3 during transmission and at rest using AES-256 encryption.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Protects sensitive location data from unauthorized access or interception.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Availability: The geo-location and distance calculation service must be available for 99.95% of operational time, with automatic failover mechanisms.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Ensures consistent access to critical location-based functionality.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: User Assistance: The system must provide clear error messages and guidance when geo-location data is incomplete, invalid, or cannot be processed.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Helps users understand and resolve issues with location-based services.

functionalRequirement: The system shall allow prospective applicants to research requirements and select relevant services or applications to initiate online.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The system must provide a clear, intuitive navigation interface for requirements research with no more than 3 clicks to access any service or application information.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Ensures ease of use for prospective applicants who may not be familiar with the system.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The system must support responsive design to be fully functional on desktop, tablet, and mobile devices with screen sizes ranging from 320px to 1920px width.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Enables access for applicants using various devices and screen sizes.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The system must load service and application information pages within 2 seconds for 95% of user requests, with a maximum page load time of 3 seconds.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Prevents user frustration and ensures quick access to critical information.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The system must implement HTTPS encryption and protect against common web vulnerabilities (OWASP Top 10) for all information research and selection processes.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Protects applicant data and ensures secure browsing of system information.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The system must be compatible with the latest versions of Chrome, Firefox, Safari, and Edge browsers, supporting at least 99% of current web standards.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Ensures widespread accessibility across different web browsers.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The system must maintain 99.9% uptime during peak application research and selection periods, with automatic error logging and recovery mechanisms.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Provides consistent availability for prospective applicants accessing system information.

functionalRequirement: The system shall allow staff members to develop staff reports for publication and distribution.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The report creation interface must provide a guided workflow with clear instructions, tooltips, and contextual help for each report section.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Supports staff in efficiently creating comprehensive reports.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The report generation system must use a modular architecture that allows easy addition of new report templates and modification of existing templates without changing core system code.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Enables flexible updates to reporting capabilities without extensive redevelopment.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The system must generate and save reports within 5 seconds for documents up to 50 pages long, supporting concurrent report creation by at least 10 staff members simultaneously.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Ensures efficient report creation and prevents performance bottlenecks.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The system must implement role-based access control (RBAC) to restrict report creation, editing, and distribution based on staff member permissions.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Protects sensitive information and ensures only authorized personnel can create and distribute reports.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The system must automatically save report drafts every 2 minutes and provide a comprehensive version control system to track all report modifications.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Prevents data loss and provides accountability for report changes.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The report generation system must support export to PDF, DOCX, and HTML formats, ensuring full formatting preservation across different document types.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Enables flexible report distribution and consumption across various platforms.

functionalRequirement: User shall be guided to a login page after successfully registering, where they can enter their credentials to access the application.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: User Error Protection: The login page must implement input validation to prevent SQL injection, with real-time client-side and server-side validation of username and password fields.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Ensures secure and guided user authentication process after registration.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: User Assistance: The login page must display clear, descriptive error messages for invalid credentials, with specific guidance on password requirements and account recovery options.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Provides helpful guidance to users during the authentication process.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Authenticity: The system must implement multi-factor authentication (MFA) as an optional security enhancement for user accounts.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Adds an extra layer of security for user authentication after registration.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Confidentiality: All login credentials must be transmitted using HTTPS with TLS 1.3 encryption, and passwords must be stored using bcrypt with a minimum work factor of 12.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Protects user credentials during transmission and storage.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Availability: The login system must maintain 99.99% uptime, with automatic failover mechanisms to prevent authentication service interruptions.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Ensures consistent access to the application after registration.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Time Behavior: The login authentication process must complete within 500 milliseconds for 95% of login attempts.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Provides a responsive user experience during authentication.

functionalRequirement: System shall ensure that dataset instances of a type created during app deployment start using the new code when a new version of the dataset type is deployed.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Adaptability: The system must support seamless data migration and version compatibility for dataset types, allowing zero-downtime updates.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Enables smooth transition between different versions of dataset types.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Modularity: The dataset type versioning mechanism must support independent deployment and rollback of dataset type implementations without affecting existing data instances.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Ensures clean and manageable code updates for dataset types.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Fault Tolerance: The system must implement a rollback mechanism that can revert to the previous dataset type version if critical errors are detected during the new version deployment.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Provides a safety net for potential issues during dataset type updates.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Time Behavior: The transition to a new dataset type version must be completed within 30 seconds for datasets up to 1 GB in size.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Ensures minimal disruption during dataset type version updates.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Integrity: The system must maintain a complete audit log of all dataset type version changes, including timestamp, user, and specific modifications.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Provides traceability and security for dataset type versioning process.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Completeness: The versioning mechanism must support 100% of existing dataset instances without data loss or corruption during type updates.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Ensures comprehensive support for dataset type version transitions.

functionalRequirement: The system shall allow site administrators to create news articles with designated publishing dates and expiry dates.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Completeness: The system must support creating news articles with both publishing and expiry dates for 100% of administrative user accounts.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Ensures full implementation of the article management functionality as specified in the functional requirement.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Time Behavior: The system must process article creation and date scheduling within 500 milliseconds, supporting up to 50 concurrent administrative users.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Provides efficient performance for administrators creating and scheduling news articles.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Operability: The article creation interface must provide clear, intuitive date selection mechanisms with calendar picker and manual input options.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Ensures ease of use for site administrators when setting publishing and expiry dates.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Availability: The article creation and scheduling system must be available 99.9% of the time during administrative working hours.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Guarantees consistent access for site administrators to manage news content.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Authenticity: The system must implement role-based access control (RBAC) to ensure only authorized site administrators can create and schedule news articles.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Protects the content creation process from unauthorized access.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Modifiability: The article management system must allow easy modification of publishing and expiry dates without requiring complete article recreation.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Provides flexibility in managing news article scheduling and lifecycle.

functionalRequirement: User shall be able to create a Gmail account by providing personal details like name, gender, password, mobile number, and location.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Completeness: The account creation process must support capturing all specified personal details (name, gender, password, mobile number, location) with no mandatory fields omitted.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Ensures comprehensive account registration as per the functional requirement.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Time Behavior: The account creation process must complete within 3 seconds from initial input to account confirmation.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Provides a responsive user experience during account registration.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: User Error Protection: Implement real-time validation for each input field with clear, specific error messages for incorrect or incomplete entries.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Helps users successfully complete the account creation process with minimal friction.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Authenticity: Implement multi-factor authentication during account creation, requiring mobile number verification via SMS or email.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Ensures the legitimacy of the account creation process and protects against fraudulent registrations.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Confidentiality: Encrypt all personal details using AES-256 encryption both during transmission and at rest in the database.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Protects sensitive personal information from unauthorized access or data breaches.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Availability: Maintain 99.99% uptime for the account creation service across all supported platforms and devices.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Ensures users can create accounts consistently without service interruptions.

functionalRequirement: A surface app page shall provide a customer with all customer system functionality.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Completeness: The surface app page must expose 100% of customer system features with no hidden or inaccessible functionality.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR specifies providing ALL customer system functionality in a single page, requiring comprehensive feature coverage.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: User Interface Comprehensiveness: The surface app page must organize all system functionalities into logically grouped, easily navigable sections with clear labeling and intuitive layout.
identifiedNFRs.justification: With multiple functionalities on a single page, clear organization and navigation are critical for user understanding.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: User Error Protection: The surface app page must implement context-sensitive help tooltips for each functionality to guide users and prevent incorrect interactions.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Comprehensive functionality increases complexity, necessitating built-in user guidance mechanisms.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Time Behavior: The surface app page must load and render all system functionalities within 2 seconds, even with complex feature sets.
identifiedNFRs.justification: A page containing all system functionalities requires optimized loading to maintain user engagement.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Modularity: The surface app page's code must be structured using component-based architecture, allowing independent updates to individual functionalities without affecting the entire page.
identifiedNFRs.justification: With comprehensive functionality, a modular design ensures easier future modifications and feature additions.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Adaptability: The surface app page must support responsive design, maintaining full functionality across desktop, tablet, and mobile device screen sizes.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Comprehensive functionality requires consistent user experience across different device types.

functionalRequirement: System shall display information and settings related to the required setting based on user input.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Correctness: The system must accurately display 100% of relevant settings and information matching the specific user input context.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires precise mapping of user input to corresponding system settings and information.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: User Error Protection: The system must provide clear validation and error messages if user input does not match any available settings, with suggestions for correct input.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Dynamic setting display requires robust handling of potentially incorrect or mismatched user inputs.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Time Behavior: The system must retrieve and display related settings within 500 milliseconds of user input submission.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Real-time setting display requires minimal latency to maintain responsive user experience.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Authenticity: The system must verify user permissions before displaying sensitive settings, implementing role-based access control for setting visibility.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Different settings may require different access levels, necessitating secure, context-aware display mechanisms.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Self-descriptiveness: Each displayed setting must include a brief, clear explanation of its purpose and potential impact when modified.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Complex settings require contextual information to help users understand their function and consequences.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Analysability: The system must log all user setting retrieval attempts with timestamp, user ID, and input parameters for auditing and troubleshooting purposes.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Tracking setting access helps in understanding user behavior and diagnosing potential system issues.

functionalRequirement: If the validation fails, system shall prompt "Wrong OTP".

identifiedNFRs.requirement: User Error Protection: The system must display the OTP error message in a clear, readable font with high contrast (minimum WCAG 2.1 AA color contrast ratio of 4.5:1) within 0.5 seconds of validation failure.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Ensures users can quickly and clearly understand the reason for OTP validation failure.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Authenticity: The system must limit OTP validation attempts to a maximum of 3 consecutive tries before temporarily blocking the account for 15 minutes.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Prevents brute force attacks and protects user accounts from unauthorized access attempts.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Fault Tolerance: The system must log all OTP validation failures with timestamp, user ID, and error type for security audit purposes.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Enables tracking and investigation of potential security incidents or system anomalies.

functionalRequirement: Information on remaining job posting time and CV access shall be reportable

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Completeness: The system must provide 100% accurate reporting of remaining job posting time and CV access status for all active job postings.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Ensures comprehensive and reliable reporting of critical job posting information.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Time Behavior: The system must generate reports on job posting time and CV access within 2 seconds for up to 100 concurrent report requests.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Provides timely access to important job posting information without significant delay.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: User Assistance: The system must display remaining job posting time in a human-readable format (e.g., 'X days, Y hours remaining') with clear visual indicators of time progression.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Helps users easily understand and interpret the remaining time for job postings.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Modularity: The reporting feature must be implemented as a separate, independent module with well-defined interfaces for future enhancements or integrations.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Allows for easier future modifications and extensions of the reporting functionality.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Interoperability: The job posting and CV access reports must be exportable in standard formats (CSV, JSON, PDF) to enable integration with external systems.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Facilitates data sharing and compatibility with other job management or reporting tools.
